title: Ayvon Resource pack
body:
# Resource pack for Ayvon SMP (Emissive)

  This resource pack add CIT models for custom swords, and emissive textures


<details>
<summary>More details</summary>

- Copper Spyglass
- Sword (beginning-end)
- Sword (mantis-blades and mantis-blades-slim)
- Elytra (phantom wings)
- Fishs in buckets (with mob fish texture)
- Axolotls in buckets (with mob axolotl texture)
- Splashes
- Emissive textures for blocks/entities/items
- Emoji
- Smoother texture of xp bar, and mount bar
- New Titel

</details>


  
<details>
<summary>Requried</summary>

- [CIT Reforged](https://modrinth.com/mod/citreforged)
- [MoreMcmeta Emissive Textures](https://modrinth.com/mod/moremcmeta-emissive)

</details>

 

# 1.0.0
  Version with old redstone model

# 2.0.0
  Version with new redstone model
